stages.name: data
stages.criteria: 100 demos: explicit object/goal/action/frame contracts, finite complete safety measurements and reviewed exclusions

stages.name: training
stages.criteria: one model first; held-out split and same-unit action MSE, optimizer update count, deterministic source/checkpoint hashes

stages.name: physical_pilot

stages.name: formal_single_task

stages.name: release_review
stages.criteria: all preceding stages accepted; no automatic scale launch from smoke or process exit
